lines.text: اکابر در ابی اثر نباید دانست با اینکه اهل هند مدار احکام بر این نهاده اند و در دولا
lines.en: the great ones should not consider it to have an effect, even though the people of India have based the foundation of judgments on this, and in the states

lines.text: دارالمرز از بانگ ابن اوی و صفیر غوک در صحو هوا بباران استدلال نمایند اگر
lines.en: of the borderlands, from the howl of the jackal and the croaking of the frog in clear weather, they deduce rain. If

lines.text: در همان ولایت نهارا علاوه اوضاع فلکی دانسته منظور دارند شاید اینست انچه
lines.en: in that same province, during the day, in addition to the celestial configurations, they consider it and keep it in view, perhaps this is what

lines.text: شرط است در احکام و در هر مقامی که لایق و مناسب باشد بعضی تنبیهات خواهد
lines.en: is a condition in judgments, and in every place that is worthy and appropriate, some warnings will

lines.text: شد انشاء الله تعا و بیشتر احکام کلی است و درست اید که عاقل و سلیم و امین و متدین
lines.en: be given, God willing, the Exalted. And most of the judgments are general, and it is correct that a wise, sound, trustworthy, and religious person

lines.text: باشد و راست قول و فارغ از علایق و عوایق و اسباب معاش و متوجه بمبداء و معاد
lines.en: should be truthful in speech, and free from attachments, obstacles, and the means of livelihood, and attentive to the Origin and the Return,

lines.text: و کم خوار و کم ازار و داننده علم طبیعی و مستحضره دلایل و متابع اثار بود و اکثر اوقات
lines.en: and eating little, and harming little, and knowing natural science, and having the proofs ready, and following the effects, and most of the time

lines.text: بمطالعه کتب احکام مشغول بوده باشد باب اول در احکام قرانات کواکب
lines.en: being occupied with studying the books of judgments. Chapter One: On the judgments of the conjunctions of the planets,

lines.text: و ان مشتمل است بر شش فصل اولا بباید دانست که هر قران که در وتد واقع
lines.en: and it consists of six sections. First, it must be known that every conjunction that occurs in an angle (watad)

lines.text: شود تاثیر او قوی است از انکه در مائلۀ الوتد حادث گردد و مائلۀ الوتد از زائلۀ الوتد
lines.en: its effect is stronger than that which happens in a succedent (ma'ilat al-watad), and a succedent is stronger than a cadent (za'ilat al-watad),

lines.text: خواه جیّد باشد و خواه ردی و اگر کوکبین در ان برج خوشحال باشند تاثیر جیّد
lines.en: whether it is good or bad. And if the two planets are happy in that sign, a good effect

lines.text: اورند و قوی او ضعیف باشد و اگر بد حال باشند بعکس و از کوکبین هر کدام قوی و مستعلی
lines.en: they bring, and its strong one is weak. And if they are in a bad state, the opposite. And of the two planets, whichever is strong and elevated,

lines.text: باشند تاثیر او در ان قران عظیم تر باید دانست و اثر منسوبات او غالب باشد بر
lines.en: its effect in that conjunction must be considered greater, and the effect of its attributions will be dominant over

lines.text: ان دیگر و از حدود نیز غافل نباید بود چرا که جیّد در حد سعد و اثر ردی در حد نحس
lines.en: that other one. And one must not be negligent of the terms (hudud) either, because a good one in the term of a benefic, and a bad effect in the term of a malefic,

lines.text: مؤکد باشد و ارباب مثلثات و وجوه نیز بی اثر نیستند و نیز بباید دانست که مقا
lines.en: is confirmed. And the lords of the triplicities and faces are not without effect either. And it must also be known that the nodes

lines.text: مشتری و زحل مخصوص احکام ماه نیست بلکه سالها و قرنها مؤثر باشند و انرا اعتبا
lines.en: of Jupiter and Saturn are not specific to the judgments of the month, but rather they are effective for years and centuries, and considering them

lines.text: بسیار است که ایراد انها در اینجا لایق و مناسب نیست و مطلب ما احکام جزئیست
lines.en: is very important, for mentioning them here is not worthy and appropriate, and our purpose is particular judgments

lines.text: که در صفایح تقویم مینویسند انشاء الله اگر اجل امان دهد و عمر وفا کند در طان باب و
lines.en: that they write in the pages of the almanac. God willing, if destiny grants safety and life is faithful, in that chapter and

lines.text: سایر احکام کلی کتابی علیحده نوشته شود فصل اوّل (در قرانات کواکب علویه)
lines.en: other general judgments, a separate book will be written. Section One: (On the conjunctions of the superior planets)

lines.text: در مثلثات اربع (قران مشتری و زحل در مثلثۀ اتشی) دلالت کند بر خروج جمعی که
lines.en: in the four triplicities. (The conjunction of Jupiter and Saturn in the fiery triplicity) indicates the emergence of a group who

lines.text: در دین شریعت سخن کنند و انتقال ملک و دولت بود خصوصاً در طرف مشرق و
lines.en: speak about the religion of the Sharia, and there will be a transfer of kingdom and state, especially in the eastern direction, and

lines.text: حرکت لشکرها و ویرانی و حرقت شهرها در ان طرف و فاش گشتن دزدیها و هلاك
lines.en: the movement of armies, and the ruin and burning of cities in that direction, and the spreading of thefts, and the perishing

sections.en: On the conjunctions of the planets with Saturn

summary.headline: Judgments of Planetary Conjunctions
summary.text: Chapter One introduces judgments of planetary conjunctions, emphasizing angularity, planetary strength, terms, triplicity lords, faces, and the long-term significance of Jupiter and Saturn’s nodes. The first section begins interpretations of Jupiter–Saturn conjunctions in the four triplicities, including religious change, dynastic transfer, armies, urban destruction, and theft in the eastern direction.
